tpl: The next attack pushes the target towards the attack direction slightly, stunning it for {0} seconds if the target collides with High Ground.
The next attack pushes the target towards the attack direction moderately, stunning it for {0} seconds if the target collides with High Ground.
The next attack pushes the target towards the attack direction greatly, stunning it for 2 seconds if the target collides with High Ground.

Immediately pushes back all enemies within range moderately in the direction this unit is facing, additionally stunning them for {0} seconds (the stun duration is increased to {1} seconds if the target collides with High Ground). If the target collides with another enemy, the enemy will also be stunned for {2} seconds.

Immediately pushes back all enemies within range greatly in the direction this unit is facing, additionally stunning them for {0} seconds (the stun duration is increased to {1} seconds if the target collides with High Ground). If the target collides with another enemy, the enemy will also be stunned for {2} seconds.

Immediately pushes back all enemies within range significantly in the direction this unit is facing, additionally stunning them for 2.5 seconds (the stun duration is increased to 4 seconds if the target collides with High Ground). If the target collides with another enemy, the enemy will also be stunned for 2.5 seconds.
